glosses: Of a person, to continue to live; to remain alive.

examples.text: Whether by a miracle or by good luck, all twenty passengers survived.

glosses: Of an object or concept, to continue to exist.

examples.text: This town has been hit by two hurricanes, but it survives.

He did not survive the accident.
